description: This file defines data structures and functions for rendering email templates related to mentor-intern task submissions and updates within a logging or notification system.

classes.name: RenderedEmail
classes.description: Immutable data structure representing a rendered email with subject, text, and HTML content.

methods.name: str _escape(s: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for safe inclusion in HTML by replacing certain characters with HTML entities.

methods.name: RenderedEmail intern_submission_to_mentor( *, mentor_name: str, intern_name: str, task_title: str, submission_text: str | None, )
methods.description: Generates a rendered email notifying a mentor about an intern's task submission, including subject, plain text, and HTML formatted email content.

methods.name: RenderedEmail mentor_update_to_intern( *, intern_name: str, mentor_name: str, task_title: str, status: str | None, remarks: str | None, )
methods.description: Creates a rendered email informing an intern about an update from their mentor regarding a task, with subject, plain text, and HTML content.

ctags.name: intern_submission_to_mentor
ctags.signature: ( *, mentor_name: str, intern_name: str, task_title: str, submission_text: str | None, )

ctags.name: mentor_update_to_intern
ctags.signature: ( *, intern_name: str, mentor_name: str, task_title: str, status: str | None, remarks: str | None, )
